versions.subject: Cisco ASA FTD Exploit CVE-2020-3452
versions.detection:
selection_endpoint:
    c-uri|contains:
        - '+CSCOT+/translation-table'
        - '+CSCOT+/oem-customization'
selection_path_select:
    c-uri|contains:
        - '&textdomain=/'
        - '&textdomain=%'
        - '&name=/'
        - '&name=%'
select_status_code:
    sc-status: 200
condition: selection_endpoint and selection_path_select and select_status_code
